purpose.summary: Copy bounded startup metadata coherently under native locks, then materialize and publish the owned Chronik startup graph outside those locks.
scope: Direct child of signed public main de29766 integrated by PR59; exact native bridge/test delta plus a finite public runner, policy, documentation and CI.
Preallocate a bounded4096-row value buffer, copy header/scalar metadata under the existing chain+mempool capture point, then release both locks before owned graph allocation and linking.
Publish only a complete graph; preserve strict/service source-generation and storage-position finish fences.
Three exact leaves run in nine fresh native processes with60 assertions and the unchanged60-second per-process deadline.
Retain all53 inherited native case bodies and every existing runner, client, source projection, budget, deadline and negative control.
exclusions: No upstream indexer, ALP parser/builder, plugin engine, dependency, consensus, activation, network identity or default change.
No pointer borrowing, skip-link optimization, shortened graph-owner lifetime, full-chain/mainnet admission, server deployment or desktop integration.
No incoming private report, raw output, binary, private history, host metadata, operator material or proof promotion.

expected_results: Linking upstream or enabling plugin component fixtures alone starts no daemon index, plugin inputs or listener. Existing profiles remain independently bound.

scenarios.command: Run startup_metadata.py --repetitions3 on the exact public source and bound regtest-plugins build; retain all inherited matrices and cold/hot service clients.

Separately exercise upstream retained-anchor and source-generation contradictions; the fixture observer closes while native progress continues.
expected_results: Inherited observer coverage only; this scenario does not establish the upstream daemon's readiness.
Both known and unknown token/transaction IDs return protobuf 503 after observer closure, never stale 200 or misleading 404.

Node RPC and chain selection continue; reconsider does not reopen observation. A persistent-tip mismatch disables HTTP on restart and logs recovery=reindex. Explicit full reindex restores canonical token metadata and byte-identical confirmed transaction output.
failure_conditions: Any accepted response after irreversible closure, missing-ID 404 from a degraded view, HTTP serving from a mismatched restarted runtime, missing mismatch diagnostic, failed canonical reindex recovery, node-authority effect, skip, timeout or nonzero exit.

limitations: Value capture remains a bounded O(mapBlockIndex) scan under native chain and mempool locks; only allocation, linking and CChain construction move outside.
The complete owned graph remains retained for upstream CXX borrow lifetime. Preallocation adds bounded transient metadata; no RSS/full-chain claim.
Owned nodes still have no skip links, so repeated ancestor lookup can remain quadratic during full reconstruction. That optimization is a separate change.
All2000-height,4096-index,4096-mempool, capture, storage and reorg limits remain unchanged; no mainnet admission.
Local build/source bindings are not independent reproducible-build provenance. Rust registry inputs are locked; OS/SDK/runner inputs are not.
Historical startup/aggregate timeouts, the private driver filter-selection failure and upstream dependency alerts remain explicit counterevidence.
counterevidence: Local diagnosis reproduced callback-capacity refusal at128 pending tickets while native mining continued. This motivates compact invalidation bookkeeping, not new consensus or token rules.

Eighteen individual native leaves passed379 assertions locally, including13 inherited leaves307 assertions and5 new leaves72 assertions. Individual-process passes do not establish a passing historical aggregate matrix.
The first runtime series ended before RPC or log output on its first startup deadline; observations2/3 were not run. A later diagnostic pass does not erase or explain that failure.
Public CI for the new exact candidate is still required. No private report is attached; this record remains Open Question/record-review-only with no artifacts.

One invocation of the new clean public client passed its five native leaves72 assertions, upstream template export4 assertions and all3 catchup/reopen repetitions with6 fresh daemons locally. Existing ALP/plugin/known-first-seen commitments remained exact at402; zero peers, six joined stops and disposable-root cleanup passed. This separate local preflight does not replace the earlier failed run or establish independent public reproduction.

The first local policy regression batch exceeded its180-second per-file driver budget in the startup-policy self-test and was interrupted during the following file. Narrow reuse let startup-policy pass136s, but a second batch reached180s in recovery-policy and was interrupted. This is distinct from daemon startup. Shared reuse of full immutable Git-object byte reads and earlier historical rejection avoid redundant subprocess work; no current file, mutable ref, signature, diff, ancestry or validation success is cached and no runtime deadline or rejection class is relaxed.

Review found that the new runner's serial cleanup could stop at the first owner failure and skip later owners. A synthetic regression failed before correction. Cleanup now attempts every owner, retains the root on any unverified cleanup and refuses a passing report; failure at either owner is covered without extending any native/daemon deadline.

The initial local test-module preflight passed three observations with nine fresh daemons, first index402, corpus102 and reopened progression403. Both existing HTTP oracles, unknown first-seen0, identity/lease/plugin inputs, positive stops and cleanup passed. This is a separate local observation, not incoming evidence or a replacement for any earlier failed run.

The public CLI adds independent exclusive-report, path-privacy and before/after source/build/binary bindings. Its final local invocation passed three repetitions/nine fresh daemons, all exact HTTP oracles and cleanup. Sixteen standard-library contract/rejection suites passed112 tests, including17 new cold runner/policy tests. Synthetic native summaries in runner self-tests are not native aggregate executions. Exact public-commit CI and independent reproduction remain separate; no local report is attached.

The first private developer-driver run passed all three new leaves for three repetitions, then failed because that private driver constructed an invalid inherited multi-suite filter. Parent and candidate binaries produced the same no-cases exit. The corrected driver reused the unchanged public selector; both records remain private and the failure is not erased.

The corrected private preflight passed22 fresh native processes/2397 assertions plus three cold-rebuild and three hot-catchup observations (15 daemons) with cleanup. It is not incoming public evidence, a fresh public-commit build or an independent reproduction; no report is attached.
